---
title: "d5ko Monocle"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(monocle3)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

### Specifying input parameters

```{r}
date = gsub("2020-","20",Sys.Date(),perl=TRUE);
date = gsub("-","",date)
Dim = "2D"
upn = "dcSubReg-20201228"
input.dir <- getwd()
nPC <- 15
cluster.res <- 0.7
output.dir <- sprintf("%s/%s.%s.Seurat.to.Monocle3.D5KO.%s", getwd(), upn, date, Dim)
dir.create(file.path(output.dir), showWarnings = FALSE)
```




### Reading in Seurat object
```{r}
print("Readingin Seurat objects")
d5ko <- subset(dcSubReg, subset = HTO_maxID == 'Hash5')
```



### Re-dimension reduction for 3D rendering __!not done__
```{r}
if (Dim == "3D") {
  
  print ("Running UMAP 3D")
  
  d5ko <- RunUMAP(object = d5ko, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:nPC, n.components = 3)
  
  print("Clustering 3D")
  
  d5ko <- FindNeighbors(object=d5ko, dims=1:nPC)
  d5ko <- FindClusters(object=d5ko, resolution=cluster.res)
  d5ko[[sprintf("ClusterNames_%.1f_%dPC", cluster.res, nPC)]] <- Idents(object = d5ko)
  
}
```

### Building the necessary parts for a basic cds

# part one, gene annotations
```{r}
gene_annotation <- as.data.frame(rownames(d5ko@reductions[["pca"]]@feature.loadings), row.names = rownames(d5ko@reductions[["pca"]]@feature.loadings))
colnames(gene_annotation) <- "gene_short_name"
```

# part two, cell information
```{r}
cell_metadata <- as.data.frame(d5ko@assays[["RNA"]]@counts@Dimnames[[2]], row.names = d5ko@assays[["RNA"]]@counts@Dimnames[[2]])
colnames(cell_metadata) <- "barcode"
```

# part three, counts sparse matrix
```{r}
New_matrix <- d5ko@assays[["RNA"]]@counts
New_matrix <- New_matrix[rownames(d5ko@reductions[["pca"]]@feature.loadings), ]
expression_matrix <- New_matrix
```

### Construct the basic cds object
```{r}
cds_from_seurat <- new_cell_data_set(expression_matrix,
                                     cell_metadata = cell_metadata,
                                     gene_metadata = gene_annotation)
```

### Construct and assign the made up partition
```{r}
recreate.partition <- c(rep(1, length(cds_from_seurat@colData@rownames)))
names(recreate.partition) <- cds_from_seurat@colData@rownames
recreate.partition <- as.factor(recreate.partition)

cds_from_seurat@clusters@listData[["UMAP"]][["partitions"]] <- recreate.partition
```

### Assign the cluster info
```{r}
list_cluster <- d5ko@meta.data[["seurat_clusters"]]
names(list_cluster) <- d5ko@assays[["RNA"]]@data@Dimnames[[2]]

cds_from_seurat@clusters@listData[["UMAP"]][["clusters"]] <- list_cluster
```

### Could be a space-holder, but essentially fills out louvain parameters
```{r}
cds_from_seurat@clusters@listData[["UMAP"]][["louvain_res"]] <- "NA"
```

### Assign UMAP coordinate
```{r}
cds_from_seurat@int_colData@listData$reducedDims@listData[["UMAP"]] <-d5ko@reductions[["umap"]]@cell.embeddings


### Assign feature loading for downstream module analysis

cds_from_seurat@preprocess_aux$gene_loadings <- d5ko@reductions[["pca"]]@feature.loadings


### Learn graph, this step usually takes a significant period of time for larger samples

print("Learning graph, which can take a while depends on the sample")

cds_from_seurat <- learn_graph(cds_from_seurat, use_partition = T)
```

### Reading in cell type information
```{r}

print("Reading in cell type information")
colData(cds_from_seurat)$celltype <- as.character(clusters(cds_from_seurat))
colData(cds_from_seurat)$celltype = dplyr::recode(colData(cds_from_seurat)$celltype,
                                                "0"="pDC", "1"="HSPC1", "2"="cDC2", "3"="monocyte", "4"="HSPC2", "5"="HSPC4", "6"="neutrophil", "7"= "HSPC3",  "8"="cDC1", "9"="mast")
```



### Plot cluster info with trajectory
```{r}
print("Plotting clusters")

if (Dim == "2D") {
  pdf(sprintf("%s/clusters.with.trajectory.%s.pdf", output.dir, Dim), width = 10, height = 10)
  clus <- plot_cells(cds_from_seurat, 
                color_cells_by = 'cluster',
                label_groups_by_cluster=FALSE,
                label_leaves=FALSE,
                label_branch_points=FALSE)
  print(clus)
  dev.off()
}


```

### Plot cell type info with trajectory
```{r}
print("Plotting cell type info")

if (Dim == "2D") {
  pdf(sprintf("%s/celltype.with.trajectory.%s.pdf", output.dir, Dim), width = 2.03, height = 1.72)
  ctype <- plot_cells(cds_from_seurat, 
                color_cells_by = 'celltype',
                label_groups_by_cluster=FALSE,
                label_leaves=FALSE,
                label_branch_points=FALSE)
  print(ctype)
  dev.off()
}
```
